svg.title: Expense claims with receipts — SoftTrack web design mockup (#133)
svg.desc: Anyone can submit an expense with a receipt from Settings → Expenses and see their own claims. Finance admins review every claim, filterable by state and person, and approve or refuse; refusal requires a reason.
svg.text: · one submitter, one decision by finance, one paper trail

svg.text: An expense row: submitter, amount (minor units), currency, date incurred, description, receipt via the attachment machinery. States submitted → approved | refused, set by a
finance admin. The submitter can edit or withdraw while submitted; after a decision the row is frozen and a correction is a new claim. No policy engine, per-diem rules or approval
